model.name: Sunday-to-Tuesday market Ridge with actual-starter QB features, team-scoped injured-reserve starters, and a net two-sided special-teams EPA feature
changed_feature_definitions: QB features in training: computed from the quarterback who took the first dropback of each game, using only stats known before that game; previously computed from a pregame projected passer
automatic uncertain-QB flag: removed (it showed no benefit in a three-way test)
added_features: ir_starters_diff: home minus away count of non-QB starters on regular injured reserve (designated-to-return not counted), read from each team's latest roster before the Tuesday prediction; a starter played 50% or more of offensive or defensive snaps for that team in any of his last three games, or averaged 50% or more for that team last season if he has not played for it this season; snaps with another team are not counted
market_features: Sunday 11:20 p.m. ET to Tuesday spread movement
Sunday 11:20 p.m. ET to Tuesday total movement
Tuesday moneyline-spread gap (moneyline prices are medianed on the decimal scale)

historical.evaluation: 2021-2025 chronological walk-forward; Tuesday US median selects HIGH; graded at best captured US Tuesday quote

interpretation: This is a historical walk-forward research result, not a guarantee of future returns. The model trains its quarterback inputs on the passer who actually took the first dropback of each game, using only stats known before that game, which is what the live model is fed. The automatic uncertain-QB flag was dropped because a three-way test showed it added nothing: the three versions tied within noise (253/434, 254/434 and this one at 251/437). Joseph chose this version because it trains on what the live model sees. The HIGH walk-forward record moved from 261/449 to 251/437, and that difference is not statistically established either way. Wilson lower bound is above 0.524. Games where the starting QB is unsettled show a probability-weighted blend of the listed QBs, and the blend is the official pick. Those blended games are not part of this benchmark.
